translations.literal: In the ninth month Sun Shi, Vice Director of the Bureau of Personnel and acting director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Ritual Office, submitted a memorial: "According to ritual texts, when offering at the Grand Temple, after the final offering descends the steps, the military dance stops, the Grand Invoker removes the offerings, the music of Abundant Peace is performed and stops after one completion, and then the music of Ordered Peace is performed—this is called seeing off the spirits.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Sun Shi of the Ritual Office memorialized: "According to ritual texts, after the final offering at the Grand Temple, when the offerer descends the steps, the military dance ceases, the Grand Invoker removes the offerings, the music Abundant Peace is performed through one completion, and then Ordered Peace is performed—this constitutes seeing off the spirits.

sentences.zh: 論語曰：『三家者以雍徹。』

translations.literal: The Analects says: "The Three Families used Yong for the removal of offerings."
translations.idiomatic: The Analects states: "The Three Families used Yong for the removal of offerings."

sentences.zh: 又周禮樂師職曰：『及徹，帥學士而歌徹。』

translations.literal: Moreover the Rites of Zhou, duties of the Music Master, says: "When offerings are removed, lead the students to sing the removal."
translations.idiomatic: The Rites of Zhou, in the duties of the Music Master, also states: "When offerings are removed, lead the students to sing the removal hymn."

sentences.zh: 鄭玄曰：『謂歌雍也。』

translations.literal: Zheng Xuan says: "This means singing Yong."
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Xuan explains: "This means singing Yong."

sentences.zh: 郊祀錄載登歌徹豆一章，奏無射羽。

translations.literal: The Record of Suburban Sacrifice records one elevation-song section for removing offerings, performed in wuye yu mode.
translations.idiomatic: The Record of Suburban Sacrifice records one elevation-song section for removing offerings, performed in wuye yu mode.

sentences.zh: 然則宗廟之樂，禮有登歌徹豆，今於終獻降階之後即作理安之樂，誠恐闕失，望依舊禮增用。」

translations.literal: Thus for ancestral temple music, the rites provide elevation song for removing offerings; now, immediately after the final offering descends the steps, the music of Ordered Peace is performed—I truly fear there is a lapse—and it is hoped that the old rites be followed and this be added."
translations.idiomatic: Ancestral temple ritual requires an elevation song for removing offerings. Currently Ordered Peace is performed immediately after the final offering descends the steps, which appears to omit this step. I request restoration of the old practice."

sentences.zh: 詔判太常寺李宗諤與檢討詳議以聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Li Zong'e, acting director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, to deliberate in detail with reviewers and report.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Li Zong'e of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to deliberate with reviewers and report.

sentences.zh: 宗諤等言：「國初撰樂章，有徹豆豐安曲辭，樂署因循不作，望如奭所奏。」

translations.literal: Li Zong'e and others said: "At the founding of the state music sections were composed, including text for the removal-of-offerings Abundant Peace section, but the Music Office has followed routine and not produced them; it is hoped that Shi's memorial be followed."
translations.idiomatic: Li Zong'e and others reported: "At the dynasty's founding, lyrics were composed for the removal-of-offerings Abundant Peace section, but the Music Office has neglected to perform them. We recommend adopting Sun Shi's proposal."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 時以將行封禪，詔改酌獻昊天上帝禧安之樂為封安，皇地祇禧安之樂為禪安，飲福禧安之樂為祺安，別製天書樂章瑞安、靈文二曲，每親行禮用之。

translations.literal: Because the Feng and Shan rites were about to be performed, an edict changed the libation-offering music of Auspicious Peace for August Heaven on High to Feng Peace, that for August Earth to Chan Peace, and that for drinking blessing to Qi Peace; two separate music sections for the Heavenly Book, Rui Peace and Spirit Text, were specially made, used whenever the emperor performed the rites in person.
translations.idiomatic: With the Feng and Shan rites imminent, the court renamed the libation music for August Heaven from Auspicious Peace to Feng Peace, that for August Earth to Chan Peace, and the blessing-drinking music to Qi Peace. Two new Heavenly Book sections, Rui Peace and Spirit Text, were composed for use whenever the emperor performed the rites in person.

sentences.zh: 又作醴泉、神芝、慶雲、靈鶴、瑞木五曲，施於朝會、宴享，以紀瑞應。

translations.literal: Five more pieces were also composed—Sweet Spring, Divine Fungus, Celebratory Clouds, Spirit Crane, and Auspicious Wood—to be applied at court assemblies and banquets, recording auspicious responses.
translations.idiomatic: Five additional compositions—Sweet Spring, Divine Fungus, Celebratory Clouds, Spirit Crane, and Auspicious Wood—were created for court assemblies and banquets to commemorate auspicious omens.

sentences.zh: 十月，真宗親習封禪儀于崇德殿，亞獻、終獻皆不作樂，因令檢討故事以聞。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Emperor Zhenzong personally practiced the Feng and Shan rites in the Chongde Hall; for the second and final offerings no music was performed; he therefore ordered investigation of precedents and a report.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Emperor Zhenzong rehearsed the Feng and Shan rites in the Chongde Hall without music for the second and final offerings, and ordered a review of precedents.

sentences.zh: 有司按開寶通禮，親郊，壇上設登歌，皇帝升降、奠獻、飲福則作樂；

translations.literal: The responsible offices, following the Kaibao Comprehensive Rites, stated that when the emperor sacrifices in person at the suburban altar, elevation song is set up on the altar; music is performed when the emperor ascends and descends, offers libation, and drinks blessing;
translations.idiomatic: According to the Kaibao Comprehensive Rites, when the emperor sacrifices in person, elevation song is performed on the altar whenever he ascends or descends, offers libation, or drinks the blessing cup;

sentences.zh: 壇下設宮縣，降神、迎俎、退文舞、引武舞、迎送皇帝則作。

translations.literal: below the altar the palace suspended set is set up; music is performed for escorting down the spirits, welcoming the offering stand, withdrawing the civil dance, introducing the military dance, and escorting the emperor coming and going.
translations.idiomatic: below the altar the palace suspended ensemble plays for escorting the spirits, welcoming the offering stand, withdrawing the civil dance, introducing the military dance, and escorting the emperor.

sentences.zh: 亞獻、終獻、升降在退文舞引武舞之間。

translations.literal: The second and final offerings and ascending and descending occur between withdrawing the civil dance and introducing the military dance.
translations.idiomatic: The second and final offerings take place between the withdrawal of the civil dance and the introduction of the military dance.

sentences.zh: 有司攝事，不設宮架、二舞，故三獻、升降並用登歌。

translations.literal: When officials conduct the rite on the emperor's behalf, the palace frame and two dances are not set up; therefore all three offerings and ascending and descending alike use elevation song.
translations.idiomatic: When officials conduct the rite, the palace frame and dances are omitted, and all three offerings use elevation song alone.

sentences.zh: 今山上設登歌，山下設宮縣、二舞，其山上圜臺亞獻、終獻準親祠例，無用樂之文。

translations.literal: Now elevation song is set up on the mountain, and below the palace suspended set and two dances are set up; for the second and final offerings at the circular altar on the mountain, following the precedent of personal sacrifice, there is no text prescribing use of music.
translations.idiomatic: For the present rites, elevation song is set up on the mountain and the palace ensemble and dances below. For the second and final offerings at the mountaintop circular altar, following the precedent of personal sacrifice, no ritual text prescribes music.

sentences.zh: 於是特詔亞、終獻並用登歌。

translations.literal: Thereupon a special edict ordered that the second and final offerings both use elevation song.
translations.idiomatic: A special edict therefore ordered elevation song for both the second and final offerings.

sentences.zh: 五年，聖祖降，有司言：「按唐太清宮樂章，皆明皇親製，其崇奉玉皇、聖祖及祖宗配位樂章，並望聖製。」

translations.literal: In the fifth year, when the Sage Ancestor descended, the responsible offices said: "According to the Tang, the music sections of the Grand Supreme Clarity Palace were all personally composed by Emperor Ming; for venerating the Jade Emperor, the Sage Ancestor, and the accompanying positions of the ancestors, it is hoped that the sage personally compose the music sections."
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, upon the descent of the Sage Ancestor, the responsible offices reported: "In the Tang, Emperor Ming personally composed all music for the Grand Supreme Clarity Palace. We request that Your Majesty personally compose the music for venerating the Jade Emperor, the Sage Ancestor, and the accompanying ancestral tablets."

sentences.zh: 詔可之。

translations.literal: An edict approved this.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the request.

sentences.zh: 聖製薦獻聖祖文舞曰發祥流慶之舞，武舞曰降真觀德之舞。

translations.literal: The sage personally composed: for offering to the Sage Ancestor, the civil dance was named the dance of Sending Forth Auspiciousness and Flowing Celebration; the military dance was named the dance of Descending Truth and Observing Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor personally composed the civil dance for offerings to the Sage Ancestor, naming it Sending Forth Auspiciousness and Flowing Celebration, and the military dance Descending Truth and Observing Virtue.

sentences.zh: 自是，玉清昭應宮、景靈宮親薦皆備樂，用三十六虡。

translations.literal: From this time, when the emperor personally offered at the Jade Clarity Manifest Response Palace and the Splendid Spirit Palace, full music was provided, using thirty-six frames.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, when the emperor personally offered at the Jade Clarity Manifest Response Palace and the Splendid Spirit Palace, full music with thirty-six frames of instruments was provided.

sentences.zh: 景靈宮以庭狹，止用二十虡。

translations.literal: At the Splendid Spirit Palace, because the courtyard was narrow, only twenty frames were used.
translations.idiomatic: At the Splendid Spirit Palace, the narrow courtyard permitted only twenty frames.

sentences.zh: 上又取太宗所撰萬國朝天曲曰同和之舞，平晉曲曰定功之舞，親作樂辭，奏于郊廟。

translations.literal: The emperor also took Taizong's composed tune Myriad States Paying Court and named it the dance of Shared Harmony, and the tune Pacifying Jin and named it the dance of Fixing Achievement; he personally composed the music text and had them performed at suburban altars and temples.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor adopted Taizong's composition Myriad States Paying Court as the Shared Harmony dance and Pacifying Jin as the Fixing Achievement dance, personally wrote the lyrics, and had them performed at suburban altars and temples.

sentences.zh: 自時厥後，仁宗以大明之曲尊真宗，英宗以大仁之曲尊仁宗，神宗以大英之曲尊英宗。

translations.literal: From this time onward, Renzong used the tune Great Brightness to honor Zhenzong; Yingzong used Great Humaneness to honor Renzong; Shenzong used Great Excellence to honor Yingzong.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, Renzong honored Zhenzong with the tune Great Brightness, Yingzong honored Renzong with Great Humaneness, and Shenzong honored Yingzong with Great Excellence.

sentences.zh: 仁宗天聖五年十月，翰林侍講學士孫奭言：「郊廟二舞失序，願下有司考議。」

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the fifth year of Tiansheng under Renzong, Hanlin Academician Lecturer Sun Shi said: "The two dances at suburban altars and temples are out of order; it is hoped that the responsible offices be ordered to investigate and deliberate."
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the fifth year of Tiansheng, Hanlin lecturer Sun Shi memorialized: "The civil and military dances at suburban altars and temples are performed out of proper sequence. I request that the responsible offices investigate."

sentences.zh: 於是翰林學士承旨劉筠等議曰：「周人奏清廟以祀文王，執競以祀武王，漢高帝、文帝亦各有舞。

translations.literal: Thereupon Hanlin Academician-in-Chief Liu Yun and others deliberated: "The Zhou people performed Qingmiao to sacrifice to King Wen and Zhi Jing to sacrifice to King Wu; Emperor Gaozu and Emperor Wen of Han also each had their own dances.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin academician-in-chief Liu Yun and others deliberated: "The Zhou performed Qingmiao for King Wen and Zhi Jing for King Wu. Emperor Gaozu and Emperor Wen of Han likewise each had dedicated dances.

sentences.zh: 至唐有事太廟，每室樂歌異名。

translations.literal: By the Tang, when serving the Grand Temple, each shrine hall had music and songs of different names.
translations.idiomatic: By the Tang, each shrine hall of the Grand Temple had its own distinct musical composition.

sentences.zh: 蓋帝王功德既殊，舞亦隨變。

translations.literal: This is because the achievements and virtues of emperors and kings differ, and the dances also change accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Because each ruler's achievements differ, the dances differ accordingly.

sentences.zh: 屬者，有司不詳舊制，奠獻止登歌而樂舞不作，其失明甚。

translations.literal: Recently the responsible offices did not examine the old system in detail; at libation offering only elevation song was performed and the music dances were not performed—the lapse in clarity is extreme.
translations.idiomatic: Recently the responsible offices, unfamiliar with the old system, performed only elevation song at libation offerings without the dances—a serious lapse.

sentences.zh: 請如舊制，宗廟酌獻復用文舞，皇帝還版位，文舞退，武舞入。

translations.literal: It is requested that, following the old system, at ancestral temple libation offerings the civil dance be used again; when the emperor returns to his spirit tablet position, the civil dance withdraws and the military dance enters.
translations.idiomatic: We request restoring the old practice: at ancestral temple libation offerings, perform the civil dance; when the emperor returns to his position, the civil dance withdraws and the military dance enters.

sentences.zh: 亞獻酌醴已，武舞作，至三獻已奠還位則止。

translations.literal: After the second offering pours the sweet wine, the military dance is performed; it stops when the third offering has been placed and the offerer has returned to position.
translations.idiomatic: After the second offering pours the sweet wine, the military dance begins and continues until the third offering is placed and the offerer returns to position.

sentences.zh: 蓋廟室各頌功德，故文舞迎神後各奏逐室之舞。

translations.literal: This is because each shrine hall eulogizes achievements and virtues; therefore after the civil dance welcomes the spirits, the dance for each hall in turn is performed.
translations.idiomatic: Each shrine hall celebrates its own ruler's achievements; after the civil dance welcomes the spirits, the dance specific to each hall is performed.

sentences.zh: 郊祀則降神奏高安之曲，文舞已作及皇帝酌獻，惟登歌奏禧安之樂，而縣樂舞綴不作，亞獻、終獻仍用武舞。」

translations.literal: At suburban sacrifice, for escorting down the spirits the tune of High Peace is performed; after the civil dance has been performed and when the emperor offers libation, only elevation song performs the music of Auspicious Peace, while the suspended music and dance choreography are not performed; the second and final offerings still use the military dance."
translations.idiomatic: At suburban sacrifices, High Peace is performed for escorting the spirits. After the civil dance and during the emperor's libation, only elevation song performs Auspicious Peace, without the suspended ensemble choreography. The second and final offerings retain the military dance."

sentences.zh: 詔從之。

translations.literal: An edict approved this.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 是時，仁宗始大朝會，羣臣上壽，作甘露、瑞木、嘉禾之曲。

translations.literal: At this time Renzong first held a great court assembly; the assembled ministers offered longevity wishes, and tunes for Sweet Dew, Auspicious Wood, and Fine Grain were composed.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Renzong held his first major court assembly with ministers offering birthday felicitations. Compositions for Sweet Dew, Auspicious Wood, and Fine Grain were created.

sentences.zh: 明道初，章獻皇太后御前殿，見羣臣，作玉芝、壽星、奇木連理之曲，厚德無疆、四海會同之舞。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Mingdao, Empress Dowager Zhangxian proceeded to the front hall, received the assembled ministers, and tunes for Jade Fungus, Longevity Star, and Extraordinary Wood with Conjoined Grain were composed, along with the dances of Boundless Deep Virtue and All Within the Four Seas United.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Mingdao era, Empress Dowager Zhangxian received ministers in the front hall. Compositions for Jade Fungus, Longevity Star, and Extraordinary Wood with Conjoined Grain were created, along with the dances Boundless Deep Virtue and All Within the Four Seas United.

sentences.zh: 明年，太后躬謝宗廟，帝耕籍田、享先農，率有樂歌。

translations.literal: The following year the empress dowager personally thanked the ancestral temple; the emperor plowed the sacred field and offered to the Progenitor of Agriculture—all had music and songs.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the empress dowager personally offered thanks at the ancestral temple, while the emperor plowed the sacred field and sacrificed to the Progenitor of Agriculture—all with accompanying music.

sentences.zh: 其後親祀南郊、享太廟、奉慈廟、大享明堂、祫享，帝皆親製降神、送神、奠幣、瓚祼、酌獻樂章，餘詔諸臣為之。

translations.literal: Afterward, when sacrificing in person at the Southern Suburb, offering at the Grand Temple, serving at the Compassionate Temple, the great offering at the Bright Hall, and the collective seasonal offering, the emperor personally composed music sections for escorting down spirits, seeing off spirits, offering silks, jade libation, and libation offering; for the rest he ordered various ministers to compose them.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, for personal sacrifices at the Southern Suburb, the Grand Temple, the Compassionate Temple, the Bright Hall, and collective seasonal offerings, the emperor personally composed music for escorting and seeing off the spirits, offering silks, jade libation, and libation offerings, commissioning ministers for the remainder.

sentences.zh: 至於常祀、郊廟、社稷諸祠，亦多親製。

translations.literal: As for regular sacrifices, suburban altars, temples, and altars of soil and grain, he also personally composed many.
translations.idiomatic: For regular sacrifices at suburban altars, temples, and the altars of soil and grain, he likewise composed many pieces himself.

sentences.zh: 景祐元年八月，判太常寺燕肅等上言：「大樂制器歲久，金石不調，願以周王朴所造律準考按修治，?閱樂工，罷其不能者。」

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Jingyou, Yan Su, acting director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and others submitted a memorial: "Great Music instruments have been made for many years; metal and stone are out of tune; it is hoped that Wang Pu's pitch standard of Zhou be used to examine, correct, and repair them, select and review music workers, and dismiss those who are incapable."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the first year of Jingyou, Yan Su and others reported: "Ceremonial instruments have aged and the metal and stone instruments are out of tune. We request recalibration against Wang Pu's pitch standard, review of musicians, and dismissal of the incompetent."

sentences.zh: 乃命直史館宋祁、內侍李隨同肅等典其事，又命集賢校理李照預焉。

translations.literal: An edict then ordered Song Qi of the Historical Archives and inner attendant Li Sui to oversee the affair together with Su and others, and also ordered Li Zhao, collator of the Hall for Assembling Worthies, to take part.
translations.idiomatic: The court appointed Song Qi of the Historical Archives and inner attendant Li Sui to oversee the project with Yan Su and others, and Li Zhao of the Hall for Assembling Worthies to participate.

sentences.zh: 於是，帝御觀文殿取律準閱視，親篆之，以屬太常。

translations.literal: Thereupon the emperor proceeded to the Hall for Viewing Literature, took the pitch standard to review it, personally inscribed it with seal script, and entrusted it to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then proceeded to the Hall for Viewing Literature, inspected the pitch standard, personally inscribed it in seal script, and entrusted it to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 明年二月，肅等上考定樂器?見工人，帝御延福宮臨閱，奏郊廟五十一曲，因問照樂音高，命詳陳之。

translations.literal: The following February, Yan Su and his colleagues submitted the recalibrated instruments and screened the musicians. Emperor Renzong reviewed them at the Palace of Extended Blessings, heard fifty-one suburban and temple compositions, then questioned Li Zhao about musical pitch and ordered a full explanation.
translations.idiomatic: The following February, Yan Su and his colleagues submitted the recalibrated instruments and screened the musicians. Emperor Renzong reviewed them at the Palace of Extended Blessings, heard fifty-one suburban and temple compositions, then questioned Li Zhao about musical pitch and ordered a full explanation.

sentences.zh: 照言：「朴準視古樂高五律，視教坊樂高二律。

translations.literal: Zhao said: "Pu's standard is five tones higher than ancient music and two tones higher than the Music Bureau's music.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhao replied: "Wang Pu's pitch standard is five tones above ancient music and two tones above the Imperial Music Bureau standard.

sentences.zh: 蓋五代之亂，雅樂廢壞，朴陋意造準，不合古法，用之本朝，卒無福應。

translations.literal: During the chaos of the Five Dynasties, ceremonial music fell into ruin. Wang Pu, in crude judgment, arbitrarily devised his pitch standard in violation of ancient practice, and its use in our dynasty has brought no sign of divine favor.
translations.idiomatic: During the chaos of the Five Dynasties, ceremonial music fell into ruin. Wang Pu devised his pitch standard by crude guesswork, in violation of ancient practice, and its use in our dynasty has brought no sign of divine favor.

sentences.zh: 又編鍾、鎛、磬無大小、輕重、厚薄、長短之差，銅錫不精，聲韻失美，大者陵，小者抑，非中度之器也。

translations.literal: Moreover, the chime-bells, bell-chimes, and sounding-stones have no differences in size, weight, thickness, or length; the copper and tin are not refined, the sound and tone lose beauty; large ones overpower, small ones are suppressed—they are not instruments of proper measure.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the chime-bells, bell-chimes, and sounding-stones lack proper gradations of size, weight, thickness, and length. Impure copper and tin produce unlovely tones: large instruments dominate, small ones are muffled—they fail to meet proper standards.

sentences.zh: 昔軒轅氏命伶倫截竹為律，後令神瞽協其中聲，然後聲應鳳鳴，而管之參差亦如鳳翅。

translations.literal: Formerly the Yellow Emperor ordered Ling Lun to cut bamboo to make pitch pipes; later he had the Divine Blind Musician harmonize the tones within them; only then did the sound respond to the phoenix's cry, and the graduated lengths of the pipes also resembled phoenix wings.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity the Yellow Emperor ordered Ling Lun to cut bamboo into pitch pipes, then had the Divine Blind Musician tune them until their tones matched the phoenix's cry and the graduated pipe lengths resembled phoenix wings.

sentences.zh: 其樂傳之亘古，不刊之法也。

translations.literal: That music has been transmitted through the ages—it is an unalterable law.
translations.idiomatic: That music has endured across the ages—it is an immutable standard.

sentences.zh: 願聽臣依神瞽律法，試鑄編鍾一虡，可使度、量、權、衡協和。」

translations.literal: I beg to be allowed to follow the pitch laws of the Divine Blind Musician, trial-cast one set of chime-bells, and thereby make dimensions, measures, weights, and balances harmonize."
translations.idiomatic: I request permission to trial-cast a set of chime-bells by the Divine Blind Musician's method, so that dimensions, measures, weights, and balances may all harmonize."

sentences.zh: 乃詔於錫慶院鑄之。

translations.literal: An edict then ordered them cast at the Court of Blessings and Celebration.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered the bells cast at the Court of Blessings and Celebration.

sentences.zh: 既成，奏御。

translations.literal: Once completed, they were presented to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: When they were finished, Li Zhao presented them to the emperor.

sentences.zh: 照遂建議請改制大樂，取京縣秬黍累尺成律，鑄鍾審之，其聲猶高。

translations.literal: Zhao then submitted a proposal requesting reform of great music; taking black millet from the capital counties, he stacked them to form a pitch measure, cast bells and tested them—their pitch was still too high.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhao then proposed overhauling ceremonial music. Using black millet from the capital counties to establish a pitch measure, he cast bells for testing, but their pitch remained too high.

sentences.zh: 更用太府布帛尺為法，乃下太常制四律。

translations.literal: He then used the Treasury Department's cloth measure as the standard and lowered the Court of Imperial Sacrifices' pitch by four tones.
translations.idiomatic: Switching to the Treasury Department's cloth measure as the standard, he lowered the pitch by four tones at the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 別詔潞州取羊頭山秬黍上送於官，照乃自為律管之法，以九十黍之量為四百二十星，率一星占九秒，一黍之量得四星六秒，九十黍得四百二十星，以為十二管定法。

translations.literal: A separate edict ordered Luzhou to deliver black millet from Mount Yangtou to the government. Zhao then devised his own method for pitch pipes: taking the measure of ninety grains of millet as four hundred and twenty stars, generally one star occupying nine seconds; the measure of one grain of millet yields four stars and six seconds; ninety grains of millet yield four hundred and twenty stars—this was made the fixed method for the twelve pipes.
translations.idiomatic: A separate edict ordered Luzhou to deliver black millet from Mount Yangtou. Li Zhao then devised his own pitch-pipe method: ninety millet grains equaled four hundred and twenty watermark divisions on the standard—one division per nine seconds, four divisions and six seconds per grain—establishing the fixed standard for twelve pipes.

sentences.zh: 乃詔內侍鄧保信監視?工。

translations.literal: The court appointed inner attendant Deng Baoxin to supervise the craftsmen.
translations.idiomatic: The court appointed inner attendant Deng Baoxin to supervise the craftsmen.

sentences.zh: 照?引集賢校理聶冠卿為檢討雅樂制度故實官，入內都知閻文應董其事，中書門下總領焉。

translations.literal: Li Zhao then recommended Nie Guanqing of the Hall for Assembling Worthies as researcher of ceremonial music institutions and historical precedents, with Inner Attendant Director Yan Wenyin directing the work under overall Secretariat-Chancellery supervision.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhao then recommended Nie Guanqing of the Hall for Assembling Worthies as researcher of ceremonial music institutions and historical precedents, with Inner Attendant Director Yan Wenyin directing the work under overall Secretariat-Chancellery supervision.

sentences.zh: 凡所改制，皆關中書門下詳定以聞。

translations.literal: All reforms were submitted to the Secretariat-Chancellery for detailed review and report.
translations.idiomatic: Every proposed reform was referred to the Secretariat-Chancellery for review and imperial report.

sentences.zh: 別詔翰林侍讀學士馮元同祁、冠卿、照討論樂理，為一代之典。

translations.literal: A separate edict ordered Hanlin Academician Reader Feng Yuan, together with Song Qi, Guanqing, and Zhao, to discuss music theory and establish a canon for the age.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor separately commissioned Hanlin Academician Reader Feng Yuan, Song Qi, Nie Guanqing, and Li Zhao to discuss music theory and establish standards for their generation.

sentences.zh: 又詔天下有深達鍾律者，在所亟以名聞。

translations.literal: An edict was also issued that anyone throughout the empire with deep mastery of bells and pitch should promptly have his name reported from his locality.
translations.idiomatic: The court also ordered local officials to report anyone in the realm with expert knowledge of bells and pitch regulation.

sentences.zh: 於是，杭州鄭向言阮逸、蘇州范仲淹言胡瑗皆通知古樂，詔遣詣闕。

translations.literal: Thereupon Zheng Xiang of Hangzhou reported Ruan Yi, and Fan Zhongyan of Suzhou reported Hu Yuan—all versed in ancient music; an edict ordered them summoned to court.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Xiang of Hangzhou recommended Ruan Yi, and Fan Zhongyan of Suzhou recommended Hu Yuan, both experts in ancient music. The court ordered them summoned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 其他以樂書獻者，悉上有司。

translations.literal: All others who submitted music books were referred to the responsible offices.
translations.idiomatic: Other music treatises submitted were forwarded to the appropriate offices.

sentences.zh: 五月，照言：「既改制金石，則絲、竹、匏、土、革、木亦當更制，以備獻享。」

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Zhao said: "Having already reformed metal and stone, silk, bamboo, gourd, clay, leather, and wood should likewise be remade to complete offerings and sacrifices."
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Li Zhao argued: "Having reformed the metal and stone instruments, we should also remake the silk, bamboo, gourd, clay, leather, and wood instruments for full sacrificial performance."

sentences.zh: 照乃鑄銅為龠、合、升、斗四物，以興鍾、鎛聲量之法，龠之率六百三十黍為黃鍾之容，合三倍於龠，升十二倍於合，斗十倍於升。

translations.literal: Zhao then cast copper into four vessels—yue, he, sheng, and dou—to establish the method of volume for bells and bell-chimes: yue on average holds six hundred and thirty grains of millet as the capacity of yellow bell; he is three times yue, sheng twelve times he, and dou ten times sheng.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhao cast copper yue, he, sheng, and dou vessels to calibrate bell volumes: the yue held six hundred and thirty millet grains as the yellow bell capacity; the he equaled three yue, the sheng twelve he, and the dou ten sheng.

sentences.zh: 乃改造諸器，以定其法。

translations.literal: He then remade the various instruments to fix the standard.
translations.idiomatic: He then remade the remaining instruments to establish the new standard.

sentences.zh: 俄又以鎛之容受差大，更增六龠為合，十合為升，十升為斗，銘曰「樂斗」。

translations.literal: Soon, because the capacity of the bell-chime vessel was somewhat too large, he further added six yue to make one he, ten he to one sheng, and ten sheng to one dou, inscribing it "Music Dou."
translations.idiomatic: Finding the bell-chime vessel's capacity still somewhat large, he adjusted the measures: six yue to one he, ten he to one sheng, ten sheng to one dou, inscribed "Music Dou."

sentences.zh: 後數月，潞州上秬黍，照等擇大黍縱累之，檢考長短，尺成，與太府尺合，法乃定。

translations.literal: Several months later, Luzhou delivered black millet; Zhao and others selected large grains and stacked them vertically, examined and corrected the length—when the measure was complete, it matched the Treasury measure, and the standard was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Months later Luzhou delivered millet. Li Zhao selected the largest grains, stacked them to form a measure, and found it matched the Treasury standard—the method was finally fixed.

sentences.zh: 先時，太常鍾磬每十六枚為虡，而四清聲相承不擊，照因上言：「十二律聲已備，餘四清聲乃鄭、衛之樂，請於編縣止留十二中聲，去四清聲，則哀思邪僻之聲無由而起也。」

translations.literal: Previously, at the Court of Imperial Sacrifices each frame of bells and sounding-stones had sixteen pieces per rack, but the four clear tones were passed over without being struck. Zhao submitted a memorial: "The twelve pitch tones are already complete; the remaining four clear tones are Zheng and Wei music—request that among the suspended set only the twelve median tones be retained and the four clear tones removed, so that mournful, perverse sounds may have no occasion to arise."
translations.idiomatic: Previously the Court of Imperial Sacrifices grouped sixteen bells or stones per rack, passing over the four clear tones without striking them. Li Zhao petitioned: "The twelve pitch tones are complete. The four clear tones belong to Zheng and Wei music. I request retaining only the twelve median tones in the suspended ensemble and removing the four clear tones, so that melancholy and corrupt sounds cannot arise."

sentences.zh: 元等駮之曰：「前聖制樂，取法非一，故有十三管之和，十九管之巢，三十六簧之竽，二十五弦之瑟，十三弦之箏，九弦、七弦之琴，十六枚之鍾磬，各自取義，寧有一之於律呂專為十二數者？

translations.literal: Feng and others rebutted, saying: "When former sages made music, they took their models from more than one source; hence there are the thirteen-pipe he, the nineteen-pipe nest, the thirty-six-reed yu, the twenty-five-string se, the thirteen-string zheng, the nine- and seven-string qin, and the sixteen-piece bell and sounding-stone frames—each takes its own meaning. How could there be one who fixed pitch and mode exclusively to the number twelve?
translations.idiomatic: Feng Yuan and his colleagues objected: "The sages drew on many models in designing music—the thirteen-pipe he, nineteen-pipe nest, thirty-six-reed yu, twenty-five-string se, thirteen-string zheng, nine- and seven-string qin, and sixteen-piece bell frames each had its own rationale. How can pitch be reduced exclusively to twelve?

sentences.zh: 且鍾磬，八音之首，絲竹以下受之於均，故聖人尤所用心焉。

translations.literal: Moreover, bells and sounding-stones are the leading voices among the eight categories of sound; silk, bamboo, and the rest receive their tuning from them—hence the sages devoted especial care to them.
translations.idiomatic: Bells and sounding-stones lead the eight categories of sound; silk, bamboo, and the rest take their tuning from them—hence the sages lavished special attention on these instruments.

sentences.zh: 春秋號樂，總言金奏；

translations.literal: In the Spring and Autumn Annals music is called, generally speaking, metal performance;
translations.idiomatic: The Spring and Autumn Annals refer to music collectively as "metal performance";

sentences.zh: 詩頌稱美，實依磬聲。

translations.literal: the Odes and Hymns offer praise, in truth relying on the sound of the stones.
translations.idiomatic: the Odes and Hymns praise virtue through the sounding-stones.

sentences.zh: 此二器非可輕改。

translations.literal: These two instruments may not be lightly altered.
translations.idiomatic: These two instruments must not be altered lightly.

sentences.zh: 今照欲損為十二，不得其法，稽諸古制，臣等以為不可。

translations.literal: Now Zhao wishes to reduce them to twelve—this is not correct method; examining ancient institutions, we consider it impermissible.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhao's proposal to reduce them to twelve lacks proper justification. Examining ancient practice, we find it unacceptable.

sentences.zh: 且聖人既以十二律各配一鍾，又設黃鍾至夾鍾四清聲以附正聲之次，原四清之意，蓋為夷則至應鍾四宮而設也。

translations.literal: Moreover, since the sages already assigned one bell to each of the twelve pitch pipes and also set up four clear tones from yellow bell through wedge bell to follow the regular tones, the original intent of the four clear tones was to provide for the four scales from yize through ying bell.
translations.idiomatic: The sages assigned one bell to each of the twelve pitch pipes and added four clear tones from yellow bell through wedge bell after the main tones—intended for the four scales from yize through ying bell.

sentences.zh: 夫五音：宮為君，商為臣，角為民，徵為事，羽為物。

translations.literal: Of the five tones: gong is the ruler, shang the minister, jue the people, zhi affairs, and yu things.
translations.idiomatic: In the five tones, gong represents the ruler, shang the minister, jue the people, zhi affairs, and yu things.

sentences.zh: 不相凌謂之正，迭相凌謂之慢，百王所不易也。

translations.literal: When they do not encroach on one another it is called correct; when they encroach on one another in succession it is called licentious—it is what no king through the ages alters.
translations.idiomatic: Non-encroachment is correctness; successive encroachment is licentiousness—a principle no ruler has ever changed.

sentences.zh: 聲重濁者為尊，輕清者為卑，卑者不可加於尊，古今之所同也。

translations.literal: Sounds that are heavy and dull are honored; those light and clear are subordinate—the subordinate may not be placed above the honored; this is agreed upon in all ages.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy, full tones rank above light, clear ones. The inferior cannot stand above the superior—universally acknowledged in all ages.

sentences.zh: 故列聲之尊卑者，事與物不與焉。

translations.literal: Therefore in ranking sounds by honor and subordination, affairs and things do not participate.
translations.idiomatic: In the hierarchy of tones, affairs and things are excluded from the ranking.

sentences.zh: 何則？

translations.literal: Why is this?
translations.idiomatic: Why is this?

sentences.zh: 事為君治，物為君用，不能尊於君故也。

translations.literal: Affairs are what the ruler governs, things are what the ruler employs—they cannot be honored above the ruler.
translations.idiomatic: Affairs are what the ruler governs; things are what he employs. Neither can rank above the ruler.

sentences.zh: 惟君、臣、民三者則自有上下之分，不得相越。

translations.literal: Only ruler, minister, and people have their own hierarchy and may not overstep one another.
translations.idiomatic: Only ruler, minister, and people have a proper hierarchy that must not be violated.

sentences.zh: 故四清聲之設，正謂臣民相避以為尊卑也。

translations.literal: Therefore the establishment of the four clear tones is precisely to let minister and people avoid one another in establishing honor and subordination.
translations.idiomatic: The four clear tones exist precisely so minister and people tones can avoid one another, preserving hierarchical order.

sentences.zh: 今若止用十二鍾旋相考擊，至夷則以下四管為宮之時，臣民相越，上下交戾，則凌犯之音作矣。

translations.literal: If now only twelve bells are used in rotation for striking, when the four pipes below yize serve as gong, minister and people overstep one another, superior and inferior clash, and encroaching tones arise.
translations.idiomatic: Using only twelve bells in rotational striking, when tones below yize serve as gong, minister and people would overstep their stations, superior and inferior would clash, and encroaching tones would arise.

sentences.zh: 此甚不可者也。

translations.literal: This is utterly impermissible.
translations.idiomatic: This is entirely unacceptable.

sentences.zh: 其鍾 磬十六，皆本周、漢諸儒之說及唐家典法所載，欲損為十二，惟照獨見，臣以為且如舊制便。」

translations.literal: The sixteen bells and sounding-stones all follow the doctrines of the Zhou and Han scholars and the Tang dynastic regulations. To reduce them to twelve is Zhao's view alone; we consider it best to keep the old system for now."
translations.idiomatic: The sixteen bells and stones follow Zhou and Han scholarly tradition and Tang court regulations. Reducing them to twelve is Li Zhao's idiosyncrasy alone. We recommend retaining the existing system."

sentences.zh: 帝令權用十二枚為一格，且詔曰：「俟有知者，能考四鍾協調清濁，有司別議以聞。」

translations.literal: The emperor ordered that twelve pieces be used provisionally as one rack, and also issued an edict: "Await someone with knowledge who can examine the four bells and harmonize clear and dull tones; the responsible offices shall separately discuss and report."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor provisionally ordered twelve pieces per rack and decreed: "When someone can properly tune the four bells to harmonize clear and dull tones, the responsible offices shall submit separate recommendations."

sentences.zh: 鍾舊飾旋蟲，改為龍。

translations.literal: On the bells the old ornament of coiled insects was changed to dragons.
translations.idiomatic: The bells' coiled-insect ornamentation was changed to dragons.

sentences.zh: 乃遣使採泗濱浮石千餘段以為縣磬。

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched to gather more than a thousand sections of floating stone from the Si Riverbank to serve as suspended sounding-stones.
translations.idiomatic: The court dispatched envoys to collect over a thousand blocks of floating stone from the Si Riverbank for suspended sounding-stones.

sentences.zh: 先是，宋祁上言：「縣設建鼓，初不考擊，又無三鼗，且舊用諸鼓率多陋敝。」

translations.literal: Earlier Song Qi reported: "The suspended ensemble includes established drums never struck in performance, lacks the three tao drums, and most existing drums are shabby and worn."
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Song Qi reported: "The suspended ensemble includes established drums that are never struck, lacks the three tao drums, and most existing drums are shabby and worn."

sentences.zh: 於是敕元等詳求典故而言曰：「建鼓四，今皆具而不擊，別設四散鼓於縣間擊之，以代建鼓。

translations.literal: Thereupon an edict ordered Feng and others to search the classics carefully and report: "There are four established drums; all are present but not struck, and four separate drums are separately placed among the suspended ensemble and struck in their place.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Feng Yuan and colleagues to research precedents. They reported: "Four established drums are present but never struck. Four separate drums placed among the ensemble stand in for them.

sentences.zh: 乾德四年，祕書監尹拙上言：『散鼓不詳所置之由，且於古無文，去之便。』

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Qiande, Director of the Secretariat Yin Zhuo submitted a memorial: "The origin of the separate drums is not recorded, and there is no ancient authority for them—it would be best to remove them."
translations.idiomatic: In Qiande 4, Secretariat Director Yin Zhuo argued: "The separate drums' origin is unrecorded and they have no ancient precedent—they should be removed."

sentences.zh: 時雖奏可，而散鼓于今仍在。

translations.literal: Although approval was granted at the time, the separate drums remain to this day.
translations.idiomatic: Although approved at the time, the separate drums remain in use to this day.

sentences.zh: 又雷鼓、靈鼓、路鼓雖擊之皆不成聲，故常賴散鼓以為樂節，而靈?、露?、路?闕而未製。

translations.literal: Moreover, the thunder, spirit, and road drums produce no proper sound when struck, so separate drums serve as rhythmic substitutes, while the spirit, thunder, and road tao drums remain unmade.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the thunder, spirit, and road drums produce no proper sound when struck, so separate drums serve as rhythmic substitutes, while the spirit, thunder, and road tao drums remain unmade.

sentences.zh: 今既修正雅樂，謂宜申敕大匠改作諸鼓，使擊考有聲。

translations.literal: Now that elegant music has been corrected, it is proposed that a directive be sent to the master craftsmen to remake the various drums so that striking them in performance produces sound.
translations.idiomatic: Now that ceremonial music is being reformed, they proposed ordering master craftsmen to remake the drums so they produce proper sound when struck.

sentences.zh: 及創為三?，如古之制，使先播之，以通三鼓。

translations.literal: They also proposed creating three Qu drums in the ancient style, shaken first to announce the three main drums.
translations.idiomatic: They also proposed creating three Qu drums in the ancient style, shaken first to announce the three main drums.

sentences.zh: 罷四散鼓，如乾德詔書。」

translations.literal: Abolish the four separate drums, as in the Qiande edict."
translations.idiomatic: Abolish the four separate drums, as the Qiande edict directed."

sentences.zh: 奏可。

translations.literal: Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 時有上言，以為雷鼓八面，前世用以迎神，不載考擊之法，而大樂所製，以柱貫中，故擊之無聲。

translations.literal: At the time someone submitted a memorial arguing that the thunder drum has eight faces, used in former ages to welcome the spirits, with no recorded method of striking in performance, but the Great Music Office's version has a pillar run through the center, hence striking produces no sound.
translations.idiomatic: At the time a memorial argued that the eight-faced thunder drum, used in antiquity to welcome the spirits, had no recorded striking method, while the Great Music Office version had a pillar through its center and produced no sound when struck.

sentences.zh: 更令改造，山趺上出雲以承鼓，刻龍以飾柱，面各一工擊鼓，一工左執?以先引。

translations.literal: They ordered a redesign: clouds rising from the mountain pedestal to support the drum, dragons carved on the pillar, one worker per face to strike the drum, and one worker holding a tao drum in the left hand to lead.
translations.idiomatic: They ordered a redesign: clouds rising from the mountain pedestal to support the drum, dragons carved on the pillar, one worker per face to strike the drum, and one worker holding a tao drum in the left hand to lead.

sentences.zh: 凡圜丘降神六變，初八面皆三擊，推而左旋，三步則止。

translations.literal: For the round altar's sixfold descent of spirits, at first all eight faces are struck three times, then pushed while turning left, stopping after three steps.
translations.idiomatic: For the round altar's sixfold spirit descent, all eight faces are first struck three times, then turned leftward, stopping after three steps.

sentences.zh: 三者，取陽數也。

translations.literal: Three takes the yang number.
translations.idiomatic: Three represents the yang number.

sentences.zh: 又載擊以為節，率以此法至六成。

translations.literal: Again loading strikes as rhythm, generally using this method through the sixfold performance.
translations.idiomatic: Subsequent rounds follow the same rhythmic pattern through all six performances.

sentences.zh: 靈鼓、路鼓亦如之。

translations.literal: The spirit drum and road drum likewise.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit and road drums followed the same procedure.

sentences.zh: 植建鼓于四隅，皆有左鞞、右應。

translations.literal: Established drums were planted at the four corners, each with left pi and right ying.
translations.idiomatic: Established drums were placed at the four corners, each flanked by a left pi and right ying drum.

sentences.zh: 乾隅，左鞞應鍾，亥之位也；

translations.literal: At the qian corner, the left pi is ying bell, in the hai position;
translations.idiomatic: At the northwest corner, the left pi drum is ying bell, corresponding to the hai position;

sentences.zh: 中鼓黃鍾，子之位也；

translations.literal: the central drum is yellow bell, in the zi position;
translations.idiomatic: the central drum is yellow bell, corresponding to the zi position;

sentences.zh: 右應大呂，丑之位也。

translations.literal: the right ying is great lu, in the chou position.
translations.idiomatic: the right ying drum is great lu, corresponding to the chou position.

sentences.zh: 艮隅，左鞞太簇，寅之位也；

translations.literal: At the gen corner, the left pi is grand beginning, in the yin position;
translations.idiomatic: At the northeast corner, the left pi drum is grand beginning, corresponding to the yin position;

sentences.zh: 中鼓夾鍾，卯之位也；

translations.literal: the central drum is wedge bell, in the mao position;
translations.idiomatic: the central drum is wedge bell, corresponding to the mao position;

sentences.zh: 右應姑洗，辰之位也。

translations.literal: the right ying is gu wash, in the chen position.
translations.idiomatic: the right ying drum is gu wash, corresponding to the chen position.

sentences.zh: 巽隅，右應仲呂，巳之位也；

translations.literal: At the xun corner, the right ying is zhong lu, in the si position;
translations.idiomatic: At the southeast corner, the right ying drum is zhong lu, corresponding to the si position;

sentences.zh: 中鼓蕤賓，午之位也；

translations.literal: the central drum is luxuriant guest, in the wu position;
translations.idiomatic: the central drum is luxuriant guest, corresponding to the wu position;

sentences.zh: 左鞞林鍾，未之位也。

translations.literal: the left pi is forest bell, in the wei position.
translations.idiomatic: the left pi drum is forest bell, corresponding to the wei position.

sentences.zh: 坤隅，右應夷則，申之位也；

translations.literal: At the kun corner, the right ying is yize, in the shen position;
translations.idiomatic: At the southwest corner, the right ying drum is yize, corresponding to the shen position;

sentences.zh: 中鼓南呂，酉之位也；

translations.literal: the central drum is southern lu, in the you position;
translations.idiomatic: the central drum is southern lu, corresponding to the you position;

sentences.zh: 左鞞無射，戍之位也。

translations.literal: the left pi is flawless pitch, in the xu position.
translations.idiomatic: the left pi drum is flawless pitch, corresponding to the xu position.

sentences.zh: 宜隨月建，依律呂之均擊之。

translations.literal: They should follow the monthly ascendant and be struck according to pitch harmony.
translations.idiomatic: They should be struck according to the monthly ascendant and pitch harmony.

sentences.zh: 後照等復以殿庭備奏，四隅既隨月協均，顧無以節樂，而周官鼓人「以晉鼓鼓金奏」，應以施用。

translations.literal: Later Zhao and others again noted that for full palace-hall performance, though the four corners already follow the monthly pitch harmony, there was nothing to regulate the music—and the Office of Zhou's Drummers "uses the Jin drum to beat metal performance"—this should be applied.
translations.idiomatic: Later Li Zhao and colleagues noted that although the four-corner drums followed monthly pitch harmony during full palace performances, nothing regulated the overall rhythm. The Zhou Office of Drummers states that "the Jin drum beats metal performance"—this should be adopted.

sentences.zh: 詔依周官舊法製焉。

translations.literal: An edict ordered manufacture according to the old method of the Office of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered them made according to the Zhou Office of Drummers' ancient method.

sentences.zh: 於是縣內始有晉鼓矣。

translations.literal: Thereupon the suspended ensemble first had Jin drums.
translations.idiomatic: The suspended ensemble thus acquired Jin drums for the first time.

sentences.zh: 古者，鎛鍾擊為節檢，而無合曲之義，大射有二鎛，皆亂擊焉。

translations.literal: In antiquity, bell-chimes were struck as rhythmic inspection, without the meaning of combining tunes; in the great archery rite there were two bell-chimes, both struck irregularly.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity bell-chimes served as rhythmic markers rather than melody instruments; the great archery rite used two bell-chimes struck without fixed pattern.

sentences.zh: 後周以十二鎛相生擊之。

translations.literal: Later Zhou used twelve bell-chimes struck in mutual generation.
translations.idiomatic: The Later Zhou struck twelve bell-chimes in mutual generation sequence.

sentences.zh: 景德中，李宗諤領太常，總考十二鎛鍾，而樂工相承，殿庭習用三調六曲。

translations.literal: During Jingde, Li Zong'e led the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and comprehensively examined the twelve bell-chimes, but the musicians handed down practice using three modes and six tunes in the palace hall.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jingde era Li Zong'e headed the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and reviewed the twelve bell-chimes, but musicians had long used three modes and six tunes in palace performances.

sentences.zh: 三調者，黃鍾、太簇、蕤賓也；

translations.literal: The three modes are yellow bell, grand beginning, and luxuriant guest;
translations.idiomatic: The three modes were yellow bell, grand beginning, and luxuriant guest;

sentences.zh: 六曲者，調別有隆安、正安二曲。

translations.literal: the six tunes are two tunes each for Long Peace and Correct Peace per mode.
translations.idiomatic: the six tunes comprised Long Peace and Correct Peace for each mode.

sentences.zh: 郊廟之縣則環而擊之。

translations.literal: Suburban and temple suspended ensembles strike them in rotation.
translations.idiomatic: Suburban and temple ensembles struck them in circular sequence.

sentences.zh: 宗諤上言曰：「金部之中，鎛鍾為難和，一聲不及，則宮商失序，使十二鎛工皆精習，則遲速有倫，隨月用律，諸曲無不通矣。」

translations.literal: Li Zong'e submitted a memorial: "Among the metal section, bell-chimes are hardest to harmonize; if one sound falls short, gong and shang lose order. If all twelve bell-chime workers are thoroughly trained, tempo will have pattern, following monthly pitch use all tunes will be mastered."
translations.idiomatic: Li Zong'e argued: "Among metal instruments, bell-chimes are hardest to harmonize—a single mistimed stroke disrupts gong and shang. If all twelve bell-chime players master their parts, tempo will be orderly and every tune accessible through monthly pitch rotation."

sentences.zh: 真宗因詔黃鍾、太簇二宮更增文舞、武舞、福酒三曲。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhenzong therefore ordered the yellow bell and grand beginning modes each augmented with civil dance, military dance, and blessing wine tunes.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhenzong ordered three additional tunes—civil dance, military dance, and blessing wine—for the yellow bell and grand beginning modes.

sentences.zh: 至是，詔元等詢考擊之法，元等奏言：「後周嘗以相生之法擊之，音韻克諧，國朝亦用隨均合曲，然但施殿庭，未及郊廟。

translations.literal: At this time an edict ordered Feng and others to inquire about striking methods. Feng and others reported: "Later Zhou once struck them by mutual generation—the tone harmonized. Our dynasty also used following-mode combined tunes, but only applied in the palace hall, not yet reaching suburban sacrifices and temples.
translations.idiomatic: The court then ordered Feng Yuan and colleagues to research striking methods. They reported: "The Later Zhou struck bell-chimes by mutual generation with harmonious results. Our dynasty also uses mode-based combined tunes, but only in palace performances—not yet at suburban sacrifices and temples.

sentences.zh: 謂宜使十二鍾依辰列位，隨均為節，便於合樂，仍得?施郊廟。

translations.literal: They proposed arraying the twelve bells by earthly branch positions, using mode as rhythmic framework for ensemble performance, and extending the practice to suburban sacrifices and temples.
translations.idiomatic: They proposed arraying the twelve bells by earthly branch positions, using mode as rhythmic framework for ensemble performance, and extending the practice to suburban sacrifices and temples.

sentences.zh: 若軒縣以下則不用此制，所以重備樂尊王制也。」

translations.literal: For xuan suspended and below this system is not used—this is to honor fully prepared music and exalt the royal system."
translations.idiomatic: Lesser ensembles below xuan rank would not use this system, preserving the full ceremonial music reserved for the royal rites."

sentences.zh: 詔從焉。

translations.literal: An edict approved this.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 隋制，內宮縣二十虡，以大磬代鎛鍾而去建鼓。

translations.literal: Under the Sui system, the inner palace suspended ensemble had twenty racks, using the great qing in place of bell-chimes and removing established drums.
translations.idiomatic: Under Sui practice, the inner palace ensemble used twenty racks, substituting the great qing for bell-chimes and omitting established drums.

sentences.zh: 唐武后稱制，改用鍾，因而莫革。

translations.literal: When Empress Wu of Tang seized power, bells were used instead, and thereafter never reformed.
translations.idiomatic: When Empress Wu of Tang seized power, bells replaced the qing, and the practice was never reformed.

sentences.zh: 及是，乃詔訪元等曰：「大磬應何法考擊，何禮應用？」

translations.literal: At this time an edict inquired of Feng and others: "By what method should the great qing be struck in performance, and for what rites should it be used?"
translations.idiomatic: The court then asked Feng Yuan and colleagues: "By what method should the great qing be struck, and for which rites should it be used?"

sentences.zh: 元等具言：「古者，特磬以代鎛鍾，本施內宮，遂及柔祀，隋、唐之代，繼有因改。

translations.literal: Feng and others fully explained: "In antiquity the special qing replaced bell-chimes, originally applied in the inner palace, then extending to gentle sacrifices; Sui and Tang successively made changes following precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Yuan and colleagues explained: "In antiquity the special qing replaced bell-chimes, originally for the inner palace and later extended to gentle sacrifices. Sui and Tang each modified the practice.

sentences.zh: 先皇帝東禪梁甫，西瘞汾陰，並仍舊章，陳於縣奏。

translations.literal: The former emperor eastward enfeoffed Mount Liangfu and westward buried at Fenyin, both keeping old regulations, displayed in suspended performance.
translations.idiomatic: The former emperor performed the eastern enfeoffment at Mount Liangfu and western burial at Fenyin, both retaining the old regulations in suspended ensemble performance.

sentences.zh: 若其所用，吉禮則中宮之縣，祀禮則皇地祇、神州地祇、先蠶、今之奉慈廟、后廟，皆應陳設。

translations.literal: As to where used: for auspicious rites the inner palace suspended ensemble; for sacrificial rites the Empress of Earth, Spirit Land Earth Empress, Progenitor of Silkworms, today's Compassionate Temple and empress temples—all should be displayed.
translations.idiomatic: For auspicious rites it belongs to the inner palace ensemble; for sacrificial rites it should be displayed at rites for Earth Empress, Spirit Land Earth Empress, Progenitor of Silkworms, the Compassionate Temple, and empress temples.

sentences.zh: 宮縣則三十六虡，去四隅建鼓，如古便。

translations.literal: The palace suspended ensemble then has thirty-six racks, removing the four-corner established drums, as in antiquity is fitting.
translations.idiomatic: The palace ensemble uses thirty-six racks without the four-corner established drums, following ancient practice.

sentences.zh: 若考擊之法，謂宜同於鎛鍾。

translations.literal: As for striking methods, they should follow bell-chimes.
translations.idiomatic: Striking methods should follow those used for bell-chimes.

sentences.zh: 比緣詔旨，不俾循環互擊，而立依均合曲之制，則特磬固應不出本均，與編磬相應，為樂之節也。」

translations.literal: Recently because of the edict's intent not to permit circular mutual striking, but to establish following-mode combined-tune regulations, the special qing naturally should not depart from its home mode, responding with chime-stones as musical rhythm."
translations.idiomatic: Given the recent edict against circular mutual striking in favor of mode-based combined tunes, the special qing should remain within its home mode, coordinating with chime-stones to mark the musical rhythm."

sentences.zh: 詔可。

translations.literal: An edict approved this.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 九月，翰林學士承旨章得象等言：「宋祁所上大樂圖義，其論武舞所執九器，經、禮但舉其凡而不著言其用後先，故旅進輩作而無終始之別。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Hanlin Academician Director Zhang Dexiang and others said: "In Song Qi's submitted Exposition of the Great Music Diagram, his discussion of the nine implements held in the martial dance— the classics and rites only give generalities without specifying the order of use, so performers advance in ranks without distinction of beginning and end.
translations.idiomatic: That September, Hanlin Academician Director Zhang Dexiang and colleagues reported: "In Song Qi's Exposition of the Great Music Diagram, the discussion of the nine implements used in the martial dance cited the classics and rites only in general terms without fixing the sequence of their use, so the dancers entered in ranks without a clear beginning or end.

sentences.zh: 且?者，所謂導舞也；

translations.literal: The tao drum, moreover, is the instrument that leads the dance;
translations.idiomatic: The tao drum, moreover, is the instrument that leads the dance;

sentences.zh: 鐸者，所謂通鼓也；

translations.literal: the duo is what is called the communicating drum;
translations.idiomatic: the bell-clapper signals the communicating drum;

sentences.zh: 錞者，所謂和鼓也；

translations.literal: the chun is what is called the harmonizing drum;
translations.idiomatic: the chun harmonizes the drums;

sentences.zh: 鐃者，所謂止鼓也；

translations.literal: the nao is what is called the stopping drum;
translations.idiomatic: the nao stops the drums;

sentences.zh: 相者，所謂輔樂也；

translations.literal: the xiang is what is called the music-assisting [clapper];
translations.idiomatic: the xiang clapper assists the music;

sentences.zh: 雅者，所謂陔步也。

translations.literal: the ya is what is called the gai-step [regulator].
translations.idiomatic: and the ya staff marks the gai steps.

sentences.zh: 寧有導舞方始而參以止鼓，止鼓既搖而亂以通鐸？

translations.literal: How could the dance-leading just begin yet be mixed with the stopping drum, and once the stopping drum has sounded be confused with the communicating bell?
translations.idiomatic: Surely the dance cannot begin with the stopping drum, nor, once the drums have ceased, be thrown into confusion by the communicating bell?

sentences.zh: 臣謂當舞入之時，左執干，右執戚，離為八列，別使工人執旌最前，?、鐸以發之，錞以和之，左執相以輔之，右執雅以節之。

translations.literal: We propose that when the dancers enter, they should hold shields in the left hand and axes in the right, arrayed in eight ranks, with artisans bearing banners at the front; the tao and bell-clapper should open the dance, the chun should harmonize it, the xiang should assist on the left, and the ya should mark the steps on the right.
translations.idiomatic: We propose that when the dancers enter, they should hold shields in the left hand and axes in the right, arrayed in eight ranks, with artisans bearing banners at the front; the tao and bell-clapper should open the dance, the chun should harmonize it, the xiang should assist on the left, and the ya should mark the steps on the right.

sentences.zh: 及舞之將成也，則鳴鐃以退行列，築雅以陔步武，?、鐸、錞、相皆止而不作。

translations.literal: As the dance nears completion, the nao should sound to withdraw the ranks and the ya should be struck to mark the gai steps, while the tao, bell-clapper, chun, and xiang all fall silent.
translations.idiomatic: As the dance nears completion, the nao should sound to withdraw the ranks and the ya should be struck to mark the gai steps, while the tao, bell-clapper, chun, and xiang all fall silent.

sentences.zh: 如此則庶協舞儀，請如祁所論。」

translations.literal: Thus the dance rites would likely be harmonized; we request following Qi's discussion."
translations.idiomatic: In this way the dance ceremony would accord with proper form; we ask that Song Qi's proposal be adopted."

sentences.zh: 其冬，帝躬款奉慈廟，樂縣罷建鼓，始以磬代鎛鍾。

translations.literal: That winter, the emperor personally paid respectful visits to the Compassionate Temple; the suspended ensemble removed established drums and for the first time used the qing in place of bell-chimes.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, when the emperor personally paid his respects at the Compassionate Temple, the suspended ensemble omitted the established drums and for the first time substituted the qing for bell-chimes.

sentences.zh: 禮官又言：「春秋隱公五年：『考仲子之宮，初獻六羽。』

translations.literal: The ritual officials further said: "In the fifth year of Duke Yin in the Spring and Autumn Annals: 'When the temple of Zhongzi was completed, the first offering was six plumes.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officials added: "The Spring and Autumn Annals records that in Duke Yin's fifth year, when the temple of Zhongzi was completed, the first offering used six plumes.

sentences.zh: 何休、范寧等咸謂，不言佾者，明佾則干舞在其中，婦人無武事，獨奏文樂也。

translations.literal: He Xiu, Fan Ning, and others all held that because the text does not mention rows of dancers, it implies that naming rows would include the shield dance; since women have no martial role, only civil music should be performed.
translations.idiomatic: He Xiu, Fan Ning, and others all held that because the text does not mention rows of dancers, it implies that naming rows would include the shield dance; since women have no martial role, only civil music should be performed.

sentences.zh: 江左宋建平、王宏皆據以為說，故章皇后廟獨用文舞。

translations.literal: Song Jianping and Wang Hong of the Jiangzuo era both took this as their doctrine, so the temple of Empress Zhang used only the civil dance.
translations.idiomatic: Song Jianping and Wang Hong of the Eastern Jin both adopted this view, so the temple of Empress Zhang used only the civil dance.

sentences.zh: 至唐垂拱以來，中宮之縣既用鎛鍾，其後相承，故儀坤等廟獻武舞，備鍾石之樂，尤為失禮。

translations.literal: From Tang's Chuigong era onward, the inner palace suspended ensemble already used bell-chimes; thereafter this was inherited, so temples such as Yikun presented the martial dance with full bell-and-stone music— an especially grave breach of ritual.
translations.idiomatic: From the Tang Chuigong period onward the inner palace ensemble used bell-chimes, and later courts followed suit, so temples such as Yikun presented the martial dance with full bell-and-stone music— a serious breach of ritual propriety.

sentences.zh: 前詔議奉慈之樂，有司援舊典，已用特磬代鎛鍾，取陰教尚柔，以靜為體。

translations.literal: In the earlier edict deliberating music for the Compassionate Temple, the responsible officials cited old precedent and already used the special qing in place of bell-chimes, taking yin instruction's esteem of gentleness and stillness as substance.
translations.idiomatic: In the earlier edict on music for the Compassionate Temple, officials had already cited precedent to substitute the special qing for bell-chimes, honoring the feminine principle of gentleness and taking stillness as its essence.

sentences.zh: 今樂去大鍾而舞進干盾，頗戾經旨，請止用文德之舞。」

translations.literal: Now the music removes great bells yet the dance advances shields and axes— this greatly departs from the classics' intent; we request using only the Civil Virtue dance."
translations.idiomatic: Now that the great bells have been removed but the dance still advances shields and axes, the practice departs markedly from the intent of the classics; we ask that only the Civil Virtue dance be used."

sentences.zh: 奏可。

translations.literal: The memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 大樂塤，舊以漆飾，敕令黃其色，以本土音。

translations.literal: The great music xun, formerly lacquered in decoration, was ordered by edict to be yellow in color, in accord with the native earth tone.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremonial xun had formerly been lacquered; an edict ordered them painted yellow to accord with the native earth tone.

sentences.zh: 或奏言：「柷，舊以方畫木為之，外圖以時卉則可矣，而中設一色，非稱也。

translations.literal: Someone memorialized: "The zhu, formerly made of square painted wood, may have seasonal flowers depicted on the outside, but to set a single color within is unfitting.
translations.idiomatic: A memorial argued: "Although the zhu had formerly been made of square painted wood with seasonal flowers on the exterior, filling the interior with a single color was inappropriate.

sentences.zh: 先儒之說曰：『有柄，連底挏之。』

translations.literal: The earlier Confucians said: 'It has a handle; the base is struck by thrusting against it.'
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Confucians said: "It has a handle, and the base is struck by thrusting against it."

sentences.zh: 鄭康成以為設椎其中撞之。

translations.literal: Zheng Xuan held that a mallet should be set within to strike it.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Xuan held that a mallet should be placed inside to strike it.

sentences.zh: 今當陋法垂久，用明制作之意有所本焉。

translations.literal: Now, since this defective method has been handed down for so long, we should make clear that the intent of the design has a proper basis.
translations.idiomatic: Since this flawed method has been handed down for so long, we should make clear that the design rests on proper foundations.

sentences.zh: 柷之中，東方圖以青，隱而為青龍；

translations.literal: Within the zhu, the east is depicted in green, concealed as the Azure Dragon;
translations.idiomatic: Within the zhu, the east would be shown in green, subtly forming the Azure Dragon;

sentences.zh: 南方圖以赤，隱而為丹鳳；

translations.literal: the south depicted in red, concealed as the Vermilion Phoenix;
translations.idiomatic: the south in red, forming the Vermilion Phoenix;

sentences.zh: 西方圖以白，隱而為騶虞；

translations.literal: the west depicted in white, concealed as the Zouyu;
translations.idiomatic: the west in white, forming the Zouyu;

sentences.zh: 北方圖以黑，隱而為靈龜；

translations.literal: the north depicted in black, concealed as the Spirit Tortoise;
translations.idiomatic: the north in black, forming the Spirit Tortoise;

sentences.zh: 中央圖以黃，隱而為神螾。

translations.literal: and the center in yellow, forming the Spirit Earthworm.
translations.idiomatic: and the center in yellow, forming the Spirit Earthworm.

sentences.zh: 撞擊之法，宜用康成之說。」

translations.literal: The method of striking should follow Xuan's explanation."
translations.idiomatic: The striking method should follow Zheng Xuan's explanation."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 又詔以新製雙鳳管付大樂局，其制，合二管以足律聲，管端刻飾雙鳳，施兩簧焉。

translations.literal: An edict further assigned the newly made twin-phoenix pipes to the Great Music Office; in their construction, two pipes were joined to complete the pitch tones, with twin phoenixes carved at the pipe ends and two reeds fitted.
translations.idiomatic: An edict also assigned the newly made twin-phoenix pipes to the Great Music Office; two pipes were joined to complete the pitch scale, with twin phoenixes carved at the ends and two reeds fitted.

sentences.zh: 照因自造葦籥、清管、簫管、清笛、雅笛、大笙、大竽、宮琴、宮瑟、大阮、大嵇，凡十一種，求備雅器。

translations.literal: Zhao thereupon personally made reed yue, clear pipes, xiao pipes, clear flutes, ya flutes, large sheng, large yu, palace qin, palace se, large ruan, and large ji— eleven kinds in all— seeking to complete the elegant instruments.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhao then personally devised eleven kinds of instruments— reed yue, clear pipes, xiao pipes, clear flutes, ya flutes, large sheng, large yu, palace qin, palace se, large ruan, and large ji— seeking a complete set of ceremonial instruments.

sentences.zh: 詔許以大竽、大笙二種下大樂用之。

translations.literal: An edict permitted the two kinds, large yu and large sheng, to be issued to the Great Music Office for use.
translations.idiomatic: The court authorized the Great Music Office to use the large yu and large sheng.

sentences.zh: 時又出兩儀琴及十二弦琴二種，以備雅樂。

translations.literal: At the time two kinds were also produced, the Dual-Principle qin and the twelve-string qin, to complete elegant music.
translations.idiomatic: Two more instruments were also produced for elegant music: the Dual-Principle qin and the twelve-string qin.

sentences.zh: 兩儀琴者，施兩弦、十二柱；

translations.literal: The Dual-Principle qin has two strings and twelve bridges;
translations.idiomatic: The Dual-Principle qin had two strings and twelve bridges;

sentences.zh: 十二弦琴者，如常琴之制而增其弦，皆以象律呂之數。

translations.literal: the twelve-string qin follows the ordinary qin form but increases its strings, all to symbolize the numbers of the pitch pipes and modes.
translations.idiomatic: the twelve-string qin followed the ordinary qin form with additional strings, all symbolizing the pitch pipes and modes.

sentences.zh: 又敕更造七弦、九弦琴，皆令圓其首者以祀天，方其首者以祀地。

translations.literal: An edict further ordered remaking seven-string and nine-string qins, all with rounded heads for sacrificing to Heaven and square heads for sacrificing to Earth.
translations.idiomatic: An edict also ordered new seven-string and nine-string qins, with rounded heads for sacrifices to Heaven and square heads for sacrifices to Earth.

sentences.zh: 帝乃親製樂曲，以夾鍾之宮、黃鍾之角、太簇之徵、姑洗之羽，作景安之曲，以祀昊天。

translations.literal: The emperor then personally composed music: using the palace of Jiazhong, the horn of Huangzhong, the mode of Taicu, and the feather of Guxian, he made the hymn Jing'an to sacrifice to August Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor personally composed a hymn, Jing'an, in the palace of Jiazhong, the horn of Huangzhong, the mode of Taicu, and the feather of Guxian, for sacrifice to August Heaven.

sentences.zh: 更以高安祀五帝、日月，作太安以享景靈宮，罷舊真安之曲。

translations.literal: He further used Gao'an to sacrifice to the Five Emperors and sun and moon, made Tai'an to enjoy at the Jingling Palace, and abolished the old hymn Zhen'an.
translations.idiomatic: He retained Gao'an for the Five Emperors and the sun and moon, composed Tai'an for the Jingling Palace, and replaced the old Zhen'an hymn.

sentences.zh: 以黃鍾之宮、大呂之角、太簇之徵、應鍾之羽作興安，以獻宗廟，罷舊理安之曲。

translations.literal: Using the palace of Huangzhong, the horn of Dalü, the mode of Taicu, and the feather of Yingzhong, he made Xing'an to present at the ancestral temple and abolished the old hymn Li'an.
translations.idiomatic: He composed Xing'an in the palace of Huangzhong, the horn of Dalü, the mode of Taicu, and the feather of Yingzhong for presentation at the ancestral temple, replacing the old Li'an hymn.

sentences.zh: 景安、興安惟乘輿親行則用之。

translations.literal: Jing'an and Xing'an were used only when the imperial carriage personally performed the rite.
translations.idiomatic: Jing'an and Xing'an were reserved for occasions when the emperor personally performed the rite.

sentences.zh: 以姑洗之角、林鍾之徵、黃鍾之宮、太簇之角、南呂之羽作祐安之曲，以酌獻五帝。

translations.literal: Using the horn of Guxian, the mode of Linzhong, the palace of Huangzhong, the horn of Taicu, and the feather of Nanlü, he made the hymn You'an for libation presentation to the Five Emperors.
translations.idiomatic: He composed You'an in the horn of Guxian, the mode of Linzhong, the palace of Huangzhong, the horn of Taicu, and the feather of Nanlü for libation presentation to the Five Emperors.

sentences.zh: 以林鍾之宮、太簇之角、姑洗之徵、南呂之羽作寧安之曲，以祭地及太社、太稷，罷舊靖安之曲。

translations.literal: Using the palace of Linzhong, the horn of Taicu, the mode of Guxian, and the feather of Nanlü, he made the hymn Ning'an to sacrifice to Earth, the Great Soil Altar, and the Great Grain Altar, and abolished the old hymn Jing'an.
translations.idiomatic: He composed Ning'an in the palace of Linzhong, the horn of Taicu, the mode of Guxian, and the feather of Nanlü for sacrifices to Earth, the Great Soil Altar, and the Great Grain Altar, replacing the old Jing'an hymn.

sentences.zh: 于時制詔有司，以太祖、太宗、真宗三聖並侑，乃以黃鍾之宮作廣安之曲以奠幣、彰安之曲以酌獻。

translations.literal: At that time an edict ordered the responsible officials that since the three sages Taizu, Taizong, and Zhenzong were jointly enshrined, the palace of Huangzhong should produce the hymn Guang'an for presenting silks and Zhang'an for libation presentation.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then instructed officials that because Taizu, Taizong, and Zhenzong were jointly enshrined, Guang'an in the palace of Huangzhong should accompany silk presentation and Zhang'an libation presentation.

sentences.zh: 又詔，躬謁奉慈廟章獻皇后之室，作達安之曲以奠瓚、厚安以酌獻；

translations.literal: An edict further ordered that when personally visiting the chamber of Empress Zhangxian at the Compassionate Temple, Da'an should be made for presenting the jade cup and Hou'an for libation presentation;
translations.idiomatic: Another edict specified that when the emperor personally visited Empress Zhangxian's chamber at the Compassionate Temple, Da'an should accompany presentation of the jade cup and Hou'an libation presentation;

sentences.zh: 章懿皇后之室，作報安之曲以奠瓚、衍安以酌獻。

translations.literal: for the chamber of Empress Zhangyi, Bao'an should be made for presenting the jade cup and Yan'an for libation presentation.
translations.idiomatic: and for Empress Zhangyi's chamber, Bao'an for jade-cup presentation and Yan'an for libation presentation.

sentences.zh: 皇帝入出作乾安，罷舊隆安之曲。

translations.literal: For the emperor's entry and exit Qian'an was made, abolishing the old hymn Long'an.
translations.idiomatic: For the emperor's entry and exit he composed Qian'an, replacing the old Long'an hymn.

sentences.zh: 常祀：至日祀圜丘，太祖配，以黃鍾之宮作定安以奠幣、英安以酌獻；

translations.literal: For regular sacrifices: at the winter solstice sacrificing at the Round Altar with Taizu as associate, the palace of Huangzhong produced Ding'an for presenting silks and Ying'an for libation presentation;
translations.idiomatic: For regular sacrifices: at the winter solstice at the Round Altar with Taizu as associate, Ding'an in the palace of Huangzhong accompanied silk presentation and Ying'an libation presentation;

sentences.zh: 孟春祀感生帝，宣祖配，以太簇之宮作皇安以奠幣、肅安以酌獻；

translations.literal: in the first month of spring sacrificing to the Lord of Life-Generation with Xuanzu as associate, the palace of Taicu produced Huang'an for presenting silks and Su'an for libation presentation;
translations.idiomatic: in early spring at the Lord of Life-Generation with Xuanzu as associate, Huang'an in the palace of Taicu accompanied silk presentation and Su'an libation presentation;

sentences.zh: 祈穀祀昊天，太宗配，作仁安以奠幣、紹安以酌獻；

translations.literal: at the prayer-for-grain sacrifice to August Heaven with Taizong as associate, Ren'an was made for presenting silks and Shao'an for libation presentation;
translations.idiomatic: at the prayer-for-grain sacrifice to August Heaven with Taizong as associate, Ren'an accompanied silk presentation and Shao'an libation presentation;

sentences.zh: 孟夏雩上帝，太祖配，以仲呂之宮作獻安以奠幣、感安以酌獻；

translations.literal: in the first month of summer praying for rain to the Supreme Lord with Taizu as associate, the palace of Zhonglü produced Xian'an for presenting silks and Gan'an for libation presentation;
translations.idiomatic: in early summer at the rain-prayer to the Supreme Lord with Taizu as associate, Xian'an in the palace of Zhonglü accompanied silk presentation and Gan'an libation presentation;

sentences.zh: 夏至祭皇地祇，太祖配，以蕤賓之宮作恭安以奠幣、英安以酌獻；

translations.literal: at the summer solstice sacrificing to the Empress of Earth with Taizu as associate, the palace of Ruibin produced Gong'an for presenting silks and Ying'an for libation presentation;
translations.idiomatic: at the summer solstice to the Empress of Earth with Taizu as associate, Gong'an in the palace of Ruibin accompanied silk presentation and Ying'an libation presentation;

sentences.zh: 季秋大饗明堂，真宗配，以無射之宮作誠安以奠幣、德安以酌獻；

translations.literal: in the last month of autumn at the great feast in the Bright Hall with Zhenzong as associate, the palace of Wushe produced Cheng'an for presenting silks and De'an for libation presentation;
translations.idiomatic: in late autumn at the great feast in the Bright Hall with Zhenzong as associate, Cheng'an in the palace of Wushe accompanied silk presentation and De'an libation presentation;

sentences.zh: 孟冬祭神州地祇，太宗配，以應鍾之宮作化安以奠幣、韶安以酌獻。

translations.literal: in the first month of winter sacrificing to the Spirit Land Earth Empress with Taizong as associate, the palace of Yingzhong produced Hua'an for presenting silks and Shao'an for libation presentation.
translations.idiomatic: in early winter at the Spirit Land Earth Empress with Taizong as associate, Hua'an in the palace of Yingzhong accompanied silk presentation and Shao'an libation presentation.

sentences.zh: 又造沖安之曲，以七均演之為八十四，皆作聲譜以授有司，沖安之曲獨未施行。

translations.literal: He further made the hymn Chong'an, developing it through seven modes into eighty-four pieces, all with pitch charts given to the responsible officials; the hymn Chong'an alone was not yet implemented.
translations.idiomatic: He also composed Chong'an, developing it through seven modes into eighty-four settings, with pitch charts delivered to officials; Chong'an alone had not yet been put into practice.

sentences.zh: 親製郊廟樂章二十一曲，財成頌體，告于神明，詔宰臣呂夷簡等分造樂章，參施?祀。

translations.literal: He personally composed twenty-one suburban and temple hymns in a celebratory style to address the spirits, and ordered chief ministers including Lü Yijian to compose additional hymns for use across the various sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: He personally composed twenty-one suburban and temple hymns in a celebratory style to address the spirits, and ordered chief ministers including Lü Yijian to compose additional hymns for use across the various sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 又為景祐樂髓新經，凡六篇：第一，釋十二均；

translations.literal: He further composed the Jingyou New Classic on the Marrow of Music, six sections in all: first, explaining the twelve modes;
translations.idiomatic: He also compiled the Jingyou New Classic on the Marrow of Music in six sections: first, explaining the twelve modes;

sentences.zh: 第二，明所主事；

translations.literal: second, clarifying the matters governed;
translations.idiomatic: second, clarifying the matters each mode governs;

sentences.zh: 第三，辨音聲；

translations.literal: third, distinguishing sounds and tones;
translations.idiomatic: third, distinguishing sounds and tones;

sentences.zh: 第四，圖律呂相生，?祭天地、宗廟用律及陰陽數配；

translations.literal: fourth, diagramming the mutual generation of pitch pipes and modes, together with the pitches used in sacrifices to Heaven and Earth and the ancestral temple and their yin-yang numerical correspondences;
translations.idiomatic: fourth, diagramming the mutual generation of pitch pipes and modes, together with the pitches used in sacrifices to Heaven and Earth and the ancestral temple and their yin-yang numerical correspondences;

sentences.zh: 第五，十二管長短；

translations.literal: fifth, the lengths of the twelve pipes;
translations.idiomatic: fifth, the lengths of the twelve pipes;

sentences.zh: 第六，歷代度、量、衡。
