translations.literal: sixth, measures, capacity, and weights through the dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: sixth, measures, capacity, and weights through successive dynasties.

sentences.zh: 皆本之於陰陽，配之於四時，建之於日辰，通之於鞮笁，演之於壬式遁甲之法，以授樂府，以考正聲，以賜羣臣焉。

translations.literal: All were rooted in yin and yang, matched to the four seasons, established in day and hour, extended through the Diqiang pipes, and developed by the methods of the Renshi and Dunjia— to be given to the Music Office, to examine and correct the proper tones, and to be bestowed upon the multitude of ministers.
translations.idiomatic: All were grounded in yin and yang, aligned with the four seasons, established by day and hour, extended through the Diqiang pipes, and developed by Renshi and Dunjia methods, then delivered to the Music Office to verify the proper tones and bestowed upon the court.

sentences.zh: 初，照等改造金石所用員程凡七百十四：攻金之工百五十三，攻木之工二百十六，攻皮之工四十九，刮摩之工九十一，搏埴之工十六，設色之工百八十九。

translations.literal: Initially, in Zhao and others' remaking of metal and stone, the labor quotas totaled seven hundred fourteen: metalworkers one hundred fifty-three, woodworkers two hundred sixteen, leatherworkers forty-nine, polishing workers ninety-one, clay workers sixteen, and color workers one hundred eighty-nine.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhao and his colleagues remade the metal and stone instruments, the labor quotas totaled 714 workers: 153 metalworkers, 216 woodworkers, 49 leatherworkers, 91 polishers, 16 clay workers, and 189 color workers.

sentences.zh: 起五月，止九月，成金石具七縣。

translations.literal: Starting in the fifth month and ending in the ninth, metal and stone were completed for seven suspended ensembles.
translations.idiomatic: Work began in the fifth month and ended in the ninth, completing the metal and stone instruments for seven suspended ensembles.

sentences.zh: 至於鼓吹及十二案，悉修飾之。

translations.literal: As for the wind-and-percussion music and the twelve cases, all were refurbished.
translations.idiomatic: The wind-and-percussion ensemble and the twelve cases were also fully refurbished.

sentences.zh: 令冠卿等纂景祐大樂圖二十篇，以載鎔金鑢石之法、歷世八音諸器異同之狀、新舊律管之差。

translations.literal: Nie Guanqing and others were ordered to compile twenty sections of the Jingyou Diagram of Great Music, recording methods of melting metal and filing stone, the forms and differences of the eight-tone instruments through the ages, and the discrepancies between old and new pitch pipes.
translations.idiomatic: Nie Guanqing and colleagues were ordered to compile twenty sections of the Jingyou Diagram of Great Music, recording methods of casting metal and shaping stone, the forms of the eight-tone instruments across history, and differences between old and new pitch pipes.

sentences.zh: 是月，與新樂?獻於崇政殿，詔中書、門下、樞密院大臣預觀焉。

translations.literal: That month the new music was presented at the Chongzheng Hall, and chief ministers of the Secretariat, Chancellery, and Bureau of Military Affairs were summoned to observe.
translations.idiomatic: That month the new music was presented at the Chongzheng Hall, and chief ministers of the Secretariat, Chancellery, and Bureau of Military Affairs were summoned to observe.

sentences.zh: 自董監而下至工徒凡七百餘人，進秩賞賜各有差。

translations.literal: From directors and supervisors down to artisans, more than seven hundred persons in all received rank advancement and rewards, each according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: More than seven hundred people, from directors and supervisors down to artisans, received rank advancement and rewards according to merit.

sentences.zh: 其年十一月，有事南郊，悉以新樂衞聖製及諸臣樂章用之。

translations.literal: When the southern suburban sacrifice was performed that November, the new music was used throughout, together with the emperor's own compositions and the ministers' hymns.
translations.idiomatic: When the southern suburban sacrifice was performed that November, the new music was used throughout, together with the emperor's own compositions and the ministers' hymns.

sentences.zh: 先是，左司諫姚仲孫言：「照所製樂多詭異，至如煉白石以為磬，範中金以作鍾，又欲以三辰、五靈為樂器之飾。

translations.literal: Earlier, Left Remonstrance Official Yao Zhongsun said: "The music Zhao made is largely bizarre and irregular, as in refining white stone to make sounding-stones, casting gold to make bells, and wishing to use the Three Celestial Bodies and Five Auspicious Creatures as ornament on the instruments.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Left Remonstrance Official Yao Zhongsun had argued: "Li Zhao's music is largely unorthodox— refining white stone into sounding-stones, casting gold into bells, and proposing to ornament the instruments with the Three Celestial Bodies and Five Auspicious Creatures.

sentences.zh: 臣愚，竊有所疑。

translations.literal: Your subject is foolish, but privately has doubts.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject, though unworthy, harbors private doubts.

sentences.zh: 自祖宗考正大樂，薦之郊廟，垂七十年，一旦黜廢而用新器，臣竊以為不可。」

translations.literal: Since the ancestors examined and corrected great music and presented it at the suburban altars and temples, nearly seventy years have passed; to dismiss and abolish it in a single day and use new instruments— your subject privately considers this inadmissible."
translations.idiomatic: Since the founders examined and corrected the great music and presented it at the suburban altars and temples, nearly seventy years have passed; to discard it overnight for new instruments seems to me inadmissible."

sentences.zh: 御史曹脩睦亦為言。

translations.literal: Censor Cao Xiumu also spoke to the same effect.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Cao Xiumu made a similar argument.

sentences.zh: 帝既許照制器，且欲究其術之是非，故不聽焉。

translations.literal: The emperor, having already approved Zhao's making of instruments and wishing moreover to investigate whether his methods were right or wrong, therefore did not heed them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had already approved Zhao's instruments and wished to test whether his methods were sound, so he did not heed the objections.
